name: skill-switchboard
description: Skill Switchboard: a Claude Code panel for your skills and connectors: Skills and Connectors tabs, a search, an Active Only filter, and a switch on every row. Point it at your skills library (a folder, a server, a git repository or a download) to install skills from it with one click.

libraryLocation.title: Library Location
libraryLocation.description: Where your skills library lives, written any of these ways: a folder (~/skills, or a synced iCloud, Dropbox or OneDrive folder), a server over ssh (my-server:/srv/skills), a git repository (github:you/skills, gitlab:you/skills, or any git address), or a download (https://example.com/skills.zip). Leave empty to use the panel without a library.

skillsFolder.title: Skills Folder
skillsFolder.description: The folder inside the library that holds the skills, one folder per skill with a SKILL.md. Leave empty when the skills sit directly in the Library Folder.
